$comment: scenario-world-referent — the escape hatch, and how it drains itself (doc 86 §10, §11).
WAVE 1: THE GATE IS ENFORCING. Run it with WORLD_REFERENT_GATE=report to get the wave-0
behaviour back for a bisect; every other invocation fails on a defect that is not written
down here. Four things are enforced and each can only ever shrink:
1. falsehoodBudget — a fault code that CONVICTS a student on a world that does not contain
its referent. A code absent from this block must have ZERO falsehoods; that is the flip.
A code present may not exceed its committed numbers, and a code BELOW them fails too,
with the number to write back. The block drains itself.
2. census — the machine-measured size of each ledger defect class. Every row must EQUAL the
number here, so a lane that repairs a class lowers this file in the same PR and the diff
is the proof of the win.
3. waveZero — the census this wave started from (expected-failures.json @ 8d32154). A row
measured ABOVE its wave-0 number needs a written entry in `raised`, or the gate fails.
Rows added in wave 1 carry null: the sharpened predicate did not exist at wave 0 and
inventing its wave-0 answer would be a number nobody measured.
4. allowlist — one entry per (scenario, rung, code) knowingly shipped red, each REQUIRING
scenario, rung, code, reason, owner and issue. An allowlisted entry that starts PASSING
fails the gate, so a lane that fixes something must delete its own entry.
The doc-86 ratchet is separate and untouched: for the four classes §10 counts to +/-0 the
measured number may never exceed the published one. See referents.ts LEDGER_BASELINE.
NOT ENFORCED, said plainly: the INERT band (22,485 rung-codes). An inert code is a declared
surface the world can never arm — a broken lesson, not a lie — and it is dominated by L12,
which has its own census row. Enforcing it would mean allowlisting the whole catalog.
WHAT MOVED IN WAVE 1, AND WHY A PREDICATE CHANGED (referents.ts carries the long form):
· T1 lane paint — rules/engine.ts:913 now requires tick.centreLinePainted before the three
lane-keeping codes may fire, so an unpainted edge DISARMS them instead of convicting on
geometry. Unpainted is no longer a falsehood; it is inert or irrelevant.
· T4 speed plates — the rule always required 'a face whose NUMBER equals edge.maxspeed'. At
wave 0 the kit had one numeral, so that collapsed to 'is this edge 50?'. Lane 3 built the
other twelve, so the collapsed form now scores correctly-signed 20 and 90 roads as lies.
T4raw keeps the collapsed form visible.
· T3b / S1 — guidanceGoalFor takes an optional context and resolves a passSignal against the
runtime's stop lines only when given one. Wave 0 passed none and therefore graded the
template; wave 1 passes the real one and grades the product.
· T8 / B4 — both were counts of a FEATURE (capped reachZones). T8 now counts caps the marker
still does not state; B4 probes the evaluator once, because one stateless stepReachZone
broke all of them at once and one latch repaired all of them at once. T8raw / B4raw keep
the wave-0 totals.

raised.T4raw: 155 -> 157 templates. Lane 15's sc-park-perp-forward and sc-park-parallel-exit sit on lot-* districts whose aisles post 20, so the wave-0 proxy ('some edge is not 50') counts two more scenarios. Two new drills, not two new defects — the defect row T4 is 0. Wave-0 T4raw = 83.
raised.T8raw: the same two templates add 3 capped reachZones (181 = 178 + 3), and the lessons-progression wave adds one more (182): sc-crossing-white-cane grew a third task — the FULL STOP before the zebra that PE-14 grades and PE-08 does not (doc 87 B54). Every one of them states its cap on the marker, which is why the defect row T8 is 0.
raised.B4raw: the same two templates each carry a capped reachZone (139 = 137 + 2). The evaluator probe passes, which is why the defect row B4 is 0.

WRONG_WAY.reason: a oneway route edge with no В1 „Влизането забранено" face built at its illegal mouth: the code convicts a wrong-way entry the world never forbade in paint. Lane 3 built the В26 numerals and the В33 kit; the В1 mouth pass is the piece it did not reach. NOTE for whoever moves a roundabout waypoint next: the route corridor is a straight-line sampler at 8 m pitch (referents.ts ROUTE_SAMPLE_M), so shifting a leg's start shifts the lattice — moving sc-rb-approach back by 8 m makes it land on rb-mini-v1's one-way RING and adds that lesson's five rungs to this row. It is a sampling artefact of a real, already-known gap (the ring has always been on that route), not a new falsehood.

HEADLIGHTS_OFF_IN_RAIN.reason: rain is compiled on the rung and the copy never says светлини/фарове, so an основна fault is billed for a duty the lesson never stated. THEO-4 forbids the bare verdict; 38 -> 16 scenarios closed, these are the tail.

HEADLIGHTS_OFF_AT_NIGHT.reason: same defect on the night rungs.

HIGH_BEAM_NOT_DIPPED.reason: night plus a lead car to dip for, and no instruction step mentions the lights.

SPEED_TOO_FAST_FOR_CURVE.reason: sc-merge-motorway-exit: the А1 post on mw-exit-v1 stands 1.0 m PAST the arc it warns about instead of 40 m before it, so the warning arrives after the car is already in the curve. T14 fell 10 -> 4 scenarios; this is the one that still convicts rather than merely misinforming.
